# JT Autoworks

> JT Autoworks (JT AUTOWORKS PTE. LTD.) is a diagnose-first car workshop at Premier @ Kaki Bukit, Singapore, focused on European cars and EVs, all makes welcome.

- Address: 8 Kaki Bukit Ave 4, #02-52, Premier @ Kaki Bukit, Singapore 415875 (Gate 1)
- WhatsApp: +65 8358 4927 (https://wa.me/6583584927)
- Phone (landline, call only): +65 6222 3102
- Email: hao@jtautoworks.com.sg
- Hours: Mon to Fri 9am to 5pm, Sat 9am to 3pm, Sun closed
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=JT%20AUTOWORKS%20PTE.%20LTD.&query_place_id=ChIJPfteMJkX2jER5y6YWmGV1v4

## Service packages (3 services each)
- Package A: Liqui Moly Top Tec 6L, $628, extra oil $29/L
- Package B: Castrol Edge 6L, $528, extra oil $20/L
- Package C: Castrol Edge 4L, $428, extra oil $20/L
